personal.name: Awais Nasir

about.heading: Who I Am
about.subtitle: Solving real-world problems with technology — from architecture to production.
bioParagraphs: I am a Software Engineer with practical experience focusing on solving real-world problems using technology, with 8+ years delivering production-grade platforms across startups, product companies, and enterprise environments.

As a Full Stack Architect, I build secure, scalable, resilient, high-performing and cost-effective software solutions — spanning backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, AI-integrated systems, and end-to-end product delivery.

I have a proven track record of collaborating closely with AI researchers and data engineers to translate advanced analytical models and unstructured data workflows into production-ready enterprise applications.
principles: Practical focus on solving real-world problems with the right technology
Architect for security, scalability, resilience, and long-term maintainability
Bridge AI research, data engineering, and production software delivery
Lead with ownership — from system design and team alignment through deployment and operations

highlights: Led architecture and delivery of a centralized Memberships Platform for QC+ and Qatar Museums, migrating 100K+ members from legacy systems using Azure Data Factory and fully digitizing corporate, individual, and event-based memberships.

Built the platform on Next.js, NestJS, Hasura GraphQL, and Azure PostgreSQL with RBAC-driven admin workflows, membership approvals, ticketing, and QNB payment integrations — now the core system for cultural event access and monetization across all museums.

Designed and deployed an AI-powered chatbot assistant enabling members to query events data and membership info conversationally, using MS Foundry IQ, custom Python orchestration, SLM for prompt intent, and pgvector embeddings.
Led end-to-end system design discussions, collaborating with infrastructure, security, operations, and memberships teams.

Delivered key architectural guidance and end-to-end technical functionalities for Daleel Aqar, a large-scale real estate platform enabling property buying, selling, and rentals, using Angular, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS within an Nx.dev monorepo.
Architected the app fully compliant with WCAG guidelines to achieve the official LevelAccess certification.
Established AWS-based DevOps practices including Dockerized services, Bitbucket Pipelines, monitoring, IAM roles management, and secure infrastructure.
Designed and delivered the architecture for a platform connecting Instagram and TikTok influencers with brands, enabling seamless pitching, negotiations, and deal finalization.
Implemented a React-based frontend integrated with a Directus headless CMS (Node.js) for dynamic content management and flexible editorial workflows.
Architected AWS-based microservices for authentication, content delivery, and notifications, with GraphQL/REST integrations between Directus CMS and AWS services.
Mentored the development team on engineering best practices, modular design, and cloud deployment strategies — leading the project from initial architecture through full deployment on AWS.

experience.periodDetail: SE2: Dec 2020 – Oct 2022 | Sr SE: Nov 2022 – Dec 2024
highlights: Performance Reporting (Jun 2023 – Dec 2024): Engineered a reporting platform with an AI-powered chatbot using OpenAI APIs, a custom Python RAG pipeline, orchestrator, and PostgreSQL (pgvector) for semantic search; integrated with dashboards via REST APIs and deployed to portal.afiniti.com.

WFM Historical Connectors (Apr 2023 – Oct 2024): Architected an ETL application to export, transpose, and load historical data from Afiniti databases into client environments, running complex migrations while maintaining data integrity.

WFM SaaS (Dec 2021 – Nov 2023): Delivered scalable tenant-based microservices with Keycloak RBAC, timezone-aware agent scheduling, forecasting, time-off workflows, and live/historical reporting for global contact centers.

Db Utility (Apr 2021 – Nov 2022): Built an internal utility for smooth deployment of database schemas, stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers on production and staging servers with backup and log tracking.

Visenya (Nov 2023 – Dec 2024): Designed an internal platform automating data pipeline creation for AI and data integration teams, with an abstraction layer over a workflow orchestration engine — collaborating daily with AI researchers and data engineers.

experience.periodDetail: SE: Sep 2018 – Sep 2019 | Team Lead: Sep 2019 – Nov 2020
highlights: Planned, executed, and delivered diverse products within time and budget using AngularJS, Angular 2+, Ionic, Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, Sequelize, and GraphQL; led sprint planning with Trello, Jira, and ClickUp.
Omni Central: Contributed to an all-in-one communication platform with SMS, WhatsApp, email, and live chat, plus CRM, inbox management, and directories — owning inbox module frontend and backend.

Built APK/IPA files post-testing and deployed iOS apps to App Store and TestFlight for public release and beta testing.
Part of the Full Stack Developer team enhancing and integrating new features on the NetSuite platform.

Integrated NetSuite with various technologies and systems, streamlining data flow and enhancing functionality across multiple business processes.
Full stack development on various PHP products using PHP Laravel and core PHP on the LAMP stack.
